frameworkName: Agentic AI Governance Framework (CSA ATF + OWASP) on GCP
frameworkDescription: Automated evidence collection for agentic AI governance aligned with CSA Agentic Trust Framework and OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026 on Google Cloud Platform

googleCloudServices.governance: Agent Registry + Agent Gateway + Semantic Governance Policy

controlSets.name: Identity & Access (CSA ATF Element 1)
controlSets.description: Zero-trust identity for AI agents using Agent Identity

controls.name: Agent Identity Verification
controls.description: All agents must have cryptographic Agent Identity

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'gemini_enterprise_agent' AND log_name LIKE '%identity%'

controls.name: IAM Least Privilege
controls.description: Agents must have only the permissions they need

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'iam_role' AND log_name LIKE '%permission%'

controls.name: Semantic Governance Policy Enforcement
controls.description: SGP must be enforced for all agent actions

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'gemini_enterprise_agent' AND log_name LIKE '%semantic_governance%'

controlSets.name: Runtime Governance (CSA ATF Element 3)
controlSets.description: Agent Gateway and Model Armor runtime enforcement

controls.name: Model Armor Protection
controls.description: Model Armor must protect all agent interactions

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'model_armor' AND log_name LIKE '%protection%'

controls.name: Agent Gateway Enforcement
controls.description: Agent Gateway must enforce access policies

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'agent_gateway' AND log_name LIKE '%policy%'

controls.name: Agent Telemetry
controls.description: All agent actions must be logged

controlSets.name: Data Boundaries (CSA ATF Element 5)
controlSets.description: VPC Service Controls and data governance

controls.name: VPC Service Controls
controls.description: VPC Service Controls with agent identities must be enforced

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'vpc_service_controls' AND log_name LIKE '%agent%'

controls.name: Data Loss Prevention
controls.description: Cloud DLP must scan agent inputs and outputs

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE resource.type = 'dlp' AND log_name LIKE '%agent%'

controlSets.name: OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026
controlSets.description: OWASP Agentic Top 10 risk coverage on GCP

controls.name: ASI01 — Agent Goal Hijack
controls.description: Prevent goal hijacking using Semantic Governance Policy

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE log_name LIKE '%semantic_governance%' AND textPayload LIKE '%goal_hijack%'

controls.name: ASI02 — Tool Misuse
controls.description: Prevent tool misuse using Agent Gateway

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE log_name LIKE '%agent_gateway%' AND textPayload LIKE '%tool_misuse%'

controls.name: ASI03 — Identity & Privilege Abuse
controls.description: Prevent identity abuse using Agent Identity

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE log_name LIKE '%agent_identity%' AND textPayload LIKE '%abuse%'

controls.name: ASI04 — Resource Exhaustion
controls.description: Prevent resource exhaustion using Cloud Monitoring

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `monitoring.googleapis.com` WHERE metric.type LIKE '%agent%' AND metric.type LIKE '%resource%'

controls.name: ASI05 — Unexpected Code Execution
controls.description: Prevent unexpected code execution using Model Armor

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE log_name LIKE '%model_armor%' AND textPayload LIKE '%code_execution%'

controls.name: ASI06 — Memory & Context Poisoning
controls.description: Prevent memory poisoning using Agent Registry and VPC Service Controls

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM `logging.googleapis.com` WHERE log_name LIKE '%agent_registry%' AND textPayload LIKE '%poisoning%'
